prompt: A pack of muscular wild beasts in a dense emerald old-growth forest, all surging forward together in unison. In the foreground a massive alpha dire wolf with coarse gray fur rears up on its hind legs, head thrown back, jaws wide open in a thunderous roar. Behind it three more beasts (a tusked wild boar, a snarling panther, an antlered stag) all rear and snarl in response to the roar, their bodies swelling with lime-green and deep-emerald primal energy crackling over their fur like a vivid aura. The roar is the source of the green light rippling through the whole pack. The background is towering moss-slicked tree trunks and shafts of green canopy light.
